display.purpose: Hero headlines and major section titles. Always uppercase with wide tracking.

editorial.purpose: Accent phrases within headings. Always italic, never uppercase.

shadows.name: gold-hover
shadows.purpose: Warm gold glow on button hover states.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Standard easing for page entrances and transitions.

motion.name: ease-duration
motion.purpose: Standard transition duration for component hover states.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The primary call-to-action. Used for key actions like booking appointments, exploring collections, and checkout.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0A0A0A 0%, #1A1A1A 100%); color: #fff; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.3em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 20px 40px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.5s ease; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { color: #D4AF37; transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D4AF37; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outline variant for secondary actions. Used alongside primary buttons or for less prominent CTAs.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #D4AF37; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.3em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 20px 40px; border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.4); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.5s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #D4AF37; color: #0A0A0A; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D4AF37; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Top-level navigation link in the header. Transparent style on hero, white-background style when scrolled.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.3em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #78716c; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.3s ease; padding: 4px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #D4AF37; border-bottom-color: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.4); }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: Product display card with 3:4 image aspect ratio, hover overlay with actions, and structured metadata below.
components.html:
Bridal

The Legacy Gown

From AED 12,000
components.css: .ds-product-card { width: 100%; max-width: 350px; } .ds-product-image { aspect-ratio: 3/4; overflow: hidden; background: #F3F1ED; margin-bottom: 16px; position: relative; } .ds-product-image img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 1s ease-out; } .ds-product-card:hover .ds-product-image img { transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-product-info { padding: 0; } .ds-product-category { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #a8a29e; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-product-name { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 500; color: #1c1917; margin-bottom: 8px; transition: color 0.3s; } .ds-product-card:hover .ds-product-name { color: #D4AF37; } .ds-product-price { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; color: #78716c; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Border-bottom style input with gold focus state. Used in forms and newsletter signup.
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { position: relative; width: 100%; max-width: 400px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid #44403c; padding: 16px 0; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: #fff; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.3s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #44403c; letter-spacing: 0.2em; } .ds-input:focus { border-bottom-color: #D4AF37; }

components.name: Social Link
components.description: Circular social media icon link with gold hover transition.
components.css: .ds-social-link { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid #44403c; color: #a8a29e; transition: all 0.5s ease; } .ds-social-link:hover { background: #D4AF37; border-color: #D4AF37; color: #fff; } .ds-social-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D4AF37; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: A warm, handcrafted sanctuary where heritage meets contemporary luxury. Atelier Riman's visual language is built on the interplay of deep tonal dark, warm ivory, and accent gold — like a private fitting room bathed in candlelight. Every surface feels deliberate, tactile, and intimate. The system rejects mass-produced, fast-fashion aesthetics in favor of architectural precision softened by editorial elegance.
keyCharacteristics: Warm layered depth through tonal surfaces, never harsh shadows
Gold as a restrained accent that signals luxury without excess
Sharp typographic hierarchy with editorial serif flourishes

rules.name: The Gold Rarity Rule
rules.body: Gold occupies ≤10% of any given screen. Its scarcity is its weight. Never use gold as a background fill for large areas, as body text, or in gradients for text.

rules.name: The Warm-Black Rule
rules.body: Never use pure #000 or #fff. All dark surfaces are onyx (#0A0A0A); all light surfaces are ivory (#FFFDF9) or bone (#FDFBF7).

rules.name: The Uppercase Rule
rules.body: Display, headline, and label text is always uppercase. Editorial accents and body text are never uppercase.

rules.name: The Editorial Rule
rules.body: Playfair Display italic is reserved for single words or short phrases within headings. Never use it for body text, full paragraphs, or multiple consecutive lines.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Depth comes from tonal contrast and spacing, not from box-shadows. Shadows appear only as response to state (hover, focus) and are always gold-tinted.

dos: Do use gold as a restrained accent (≤10% of any screen). Its rarity is its power.
Do use onyx (#0A0A0A) for dark surfaces and ivory (#FFFDF9) for light surfaces — never pure black or white.
Do use Plus Jakarta Sans uppercase with wide tracking for all headings and navigation.
Do use Playfair Display italic sparingly for editorial accent words within headings.
Do use sharp edges (no border-radius) on buttons, cards, and containers.
Do use warm tonal layering for depth rather than box-shadows.
donts: Don't use gold as a background fill for large areas or as body text.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text with gradients) — decorative, never meaningful.
Don't use pure #000 or #fff anywhere — tint neutrals toward the brand warmth.
Don't use border-radius on buttons, cards, or containers — sharp edges are architectural.
Don't use glassmorphism or frosted-glass effects as default decorative treatment.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left/right >1px colored accents on cards or callouts).
Don't do fast fashion aesthetics — avoid anything mass-produced, trendy, or disposable-feeling.
